purpose: Calibration evidence kept separate from UIX-100 acceptance scoring.

notes: Visual tone is restrained, evidence-oriented and appropriate for consequential B2B operating work.
The route, evidence packet, decision-owner and closure concepts materially support the product thesis rather than functioning as decorative copy.
Claims are bounded: the page distinguishes candidate signals, validated findings, authorized actions and verified outcomes.
The field/bone/brass palette, route-rail motif and evidence-led information architecture create a distinct identity.
The layout still uses familiar landing-page primitives such as a hero, section bands and CTA form, but composition and content model reduce generic-template resemblance.

scoringBoundary.reason: Issue #78 requires domain and similarity calibration to remain separate from acceptance scoring.
